entries.reason: The root manifest owns shared workspace scripts and hoisted dependencies that can be consumed by app and package workspaces.
entries.retirementAction: Remove root dependencies only after checking descendant workspaces, package scripts, builds, and focused tests.
entries.proofCommand: npm run typecheck && npm run lint

entries.reason: Marketing keeps build-sensitive dependencies that static import analysis may not see: Tailwind is loaded through CSS/PostCSS, and sharp supports production Next image optimization.
entries.retirementAction: Remove only after checking marketing CSS/PostCSS config, Next image behavior, production build output, and focused marketing tests.
entries.proofCommand: npm run test:marketing && npm run build:marketing

entries.reason: Portal keeps build-sensitive dependencies that static import analysis may not see: Tailwind is loaded through CSS/PostCSS, and sharp supports production Next image optimization.
entries.retirementAction: Remove only after checking portal CSS/PostCSS config, Next image behavior, production build output, and focused portal tests.
entries.proofCommand: npm run test:portal:shell && npm run build:portal

entries.reason: Next App Router discovers these files by filesystem convention rather than normal imports.
entries.retirementAction: Do not delete unless the route is intentionally retired, linked routes are updated, and app tests or builds prove the removal.
entries.proofCommand: npm run build:marketing && npm run build:portal

entries.reason: Package index files define public package contracts and may expose APIs used by package consumers or future app work.
entries.retirementAction: Remove exports only after confirming no app/package consumer, test, or documented public package contract needs them.
entries.proofCommand: npm run packages:guard && npm run typecheck

entries.reason: The UI foundation exports component prop and variant types as its documented adoption contract; application consumers may use those types without the catalogue importing every export directly.
entries.retirementAction: Remove an export only after checking the foundation barrel, catalogue, adopting portal screens, tests, and docs/ui-foundation.md.
entries.proofCommand: rg "from ['\"]@/components/(ui/foundation|layout/PageHeader)" apps/portal && npx vitest run apps/portal/components/ui/foundation apps/portal/components/layout/PageHeader.test.tsx && npm run typecheck

entries.reason: Playwright specs and setup files are invoked by Playwright projects and npm scripts rather than imported by source code.
entries.retirementAction: Delete only when the matching npm script, Playwright project, and testing docs are removed or rerouted.

entries.reason: Vitest resolves marketing public-token helpers and Next's server-only marker through aliases in vitest.config.ts rather than source imports.
entries.retirementAction: Delete only after removing or rerouting the matching Vitest aliases and running affected portal/marketing tests.
entries.proofCommand: rg "test/shims|marketing-publicQuote|marketing-publicInvoice|server-only" vitest.config.ts apps test && npm run test:portal:shell && npm run test:marketing

entries.reason: Workbench QA fixture definitions are loaded by the server-only `/qa/design-workbench-fixture` route and intentionally guard against browser imports with Next's `server-only` marker.
entries.retirementAction: Remove fixture modules only after checking the QA fixture route, Playwright portal fixture lane, fixture registry slugs, and workbench docs.

entries.reason: Scripts are often invoked from package scripts, CI, docs, or manual operations rather than source imports.
entries.retirementAction: Retire a script only after checking package scripts, CI workflows, docs, and operational owner docs.

entries.reason: The portal compatibility service-role helper imports @supabase/supabase-js directly while root operational scripts and app workspaces also declare Supabase dependencies for their own execution contexts.
entries.retirementAction: Remove only after replacing the compatibility helper and confirming root scripts, portal runtime imports, service-role guards, and workspace package manifests still resolve correctly.
entries.proofCommand: npx vitest run apps/portal/lib/supabaseClient.test.ts apps/portal/lib/supabaseClient.boundaries.test.ts && npm run service-role:changed

entries.reason: The legacy estimate viewer route imports this browser repo action through a dynamic Next route that Knip does not currently reach.
entries.retirementAction: Remove only after retiring or replacing apps/portal/app/staff/projects/[projectId]/estimate/[estimateId]/EstimateViewerClient.tsx.
entries.proofCommand: rg "deleteEstimate" apps/portal/app/staff/projects/[projectId] apps/portal/lib/repo && npx vitest run apps/portal/app/staff/projects/[projectId]/estimate/[estimateId] apps/portal/lib/repo

entries.reason: The legacy estimate viewer route imports these output and export helpers through a dynamic Next route that Knip does not currently reach. The admin import route also consumes the JSON import helpers.
entries.retirementAction: Remove only after retiring or replacing apps/portal/app/staff/projects/[projectId]/estimate/[estimateId]/EstimateViewerClient.tsx and confirming the admin import flow no longer needs the shared JSON import helpers.
entries.proofCommand: rg "EstimateWarnings|OutputsPanel|downloadCsv|downloadJson|downloadText|makeEstimateExportFile|importExportFile|readJsonFile" apps/portal/app/staff/projects/[projectId] apps/portal/app/admin/imports apps/portal/components apps/portal/lib/export && npx vitest run apps/portal/app/staff/projects/[projectId]/estimate/[estimateId] apps/portal/app/admin/imports apps/portal/components/outputs

entries.reason: The legacy quote editor and quote print routes import these browser repo actions through dynamic Next routes that Knip does not currently reach.
entries.retirementAction: Remove only after retiring or replacing apps/portal/app/staff/projects/[projectId]/quotes/[quoteId] and its print route.
entries.proofCommand: rg "getQuote|deleteQuote|markQuotePaid|quoteIsLocked" apps/portal/app/staff/projects/[projectId] apps/portal/lib/repo && npx vitest run apps/portal/lib/repo/quotesRepo.test.ts

entries.reason: The legacy quote editor and print routes import this older quote model/helper surface through dynamic Next routes that Knip does not currently reach. The legacy browser quote repo also consumes the same Quote and QuoteContent shapes.
entries.retirementAction: Remove only after retiring or replacing apps/portal/app/staff/projects/[projectId]/quotes/[quoteId], its print route, and the legacy browser quote repo.
entries.proofCommand: rg "quoteCustomerTotalIncGst|quoteLabel|quoteStatusLabel|@/lib/types/quote" apps/portal/app/staff/projects/[projectId]/quotes apps/portal/lib/repo/quotesRepo.ts apps/portal/lib/types/quote.ts && npx vitest run apps/portal/lib/repo/quotesRepo.test.ts

entries.reason: Generated profile assets are produced by repo tooling and may be referenced through geometry package internals.
entries.retirementAction: Regenerate or remove only through the geometry asset generation workflow and package tests.
entries.proofCommand: npm run geometry:generate-profile-assets && npm run typecheck
